subject.title: OpenWebUI image uploads reach image tool as empty image via /v1/chat/completions on 2026.5.18

question: Should this stay open as a live OpenWebUI image-upload reproduction target until a raw `/v1/chat/completions` request capture shows where the image becomes empty?
rationale: Current main proves standard `image_url` forwarding, but the affected report postdates that shipped fix and lacks the raw OpenWebUI payload needed to identify whether OpenClaw receives, drops, or transforms the image.

options.title: Keep as live-repro target
options.body: Keep this issue open with no new autonomous fix PR until a redacted request capture or maintainer-run OpenWebUI image-upload repro identifies the failing hop.

options.title: Close as generic image_url fixed
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept current standard `image_url` support as enough despite the later empty-tool-argument log.

options.title: Fold into broader image-drop tracking
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83666 as the canonical live-repro queue if maintainers want one broader image-drop issue instead of this OpenWebUI-specific one.

recommendation.title: Keep as live-repro target
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open with no new autonomous fix PR until a redacted request capture or maintainer-run OpenWebUI image-upload repro identifies the failing hop.

likelyOwner.reason: The current missing proof concerns the gateway OpenAI-compatible image parser that vincentkoc introduced and recently maintained.
